mapper.select: SELECT p.* FROM sys_permission p JOIN sys_role_permission rp ON rp.permission_id = p.id JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.role_id = rp.role_id JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = ur.user_id AND u.status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE ur.user_id = #{uid}
SELECT role_id FROM sys_user_role WHERE user_id = #{uid}
SELECT * FROM sys_role ORDER BY id
SELECT permission_id FROM sys_role_permission WHERE role_id = #{roleId}
SELECT * FROM sys_permission ORDER BY module, id
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_user_role ur JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id AND r.code = #{roleCode}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_user_role (user_id, role_id) VALUES (#{userId}, #{roleId}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
INSERT INTO sys_role_permission (role_id, permission_id) VALUES (#{roleId}, #{permissionId}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
INSERT INTO sys_role (code, name, remark) VALUES (#{code}, #{name}, #{remark})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM sys_role WHERE id = #{id} AND built_in = false
